citation.authors: Cheah KL, Norhayati MN, Husniati Yaacob L, Abdul Rahman R

cited_by.title: Ashwagandha: stress, sleep, thyroid and liver cautions

record.population: Adults aged 18 and over in five randomised trials (insomnia subgroup included)
record.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised trials of ashwagandha extract against placebo for sleep
record.finding: Ashwagandha extract gave a small but significant improvement in overall sleep (standardised mean difference -0.59). Effects were larger in people diagnosed with insomnia, at 600 mg a day or more, and over eight weeks or more.
record.note: Five trials only. Ethnicity not reported in the abstract.
